basis.file25_plan: Complete Public UI, Profile Timeline and Visual Experience — Final Harmonized Specification 2.0 plus governing addenda
basis.central_plan: Sabri Social Homeopathy Platform Definitive/Consolidated Governing Master Plan 2026
basis.method: Twenty sequential plan-to-code and cross-file reviews. Each scope was completed before its correction set was applied; repository evidence is not staging/live evidence.

reviews.focus: exact repository baseline and prior CI
reviews.finding: Current main 3075224089506fed19af1441ebf3556c2d5230b5 and CI run 1784 were verified as repository evidence only.

reviews.focus: File 25 plan and central ownership law
reviews.finding: File 25 remains presentation owner; native profile, publication, shell, security and global search authorities remain external canonical owners.
File 07 had advanced to 1.2.1/DB1.1.1/contract1.2.1/projection3 at 2f4a8970..., while File 25 current-source evidence was stale.
reviews.correction: Refreshed current File 07 source evidence without treating it as staging/live truth.

reviews.finding: The coded interface omitted seven methods explicitly required by File 25 section 46.
reviews.correction: Completed the provider contract for normalization, canonical URL, visibility, actions, metrics, correction state and sync registration.

reviews.finding: The File 21 adapter did not implement the newly reconciled full plan contract.
reviews.correction: Implemented every required method while preserving File 21 ownership and returning no invented metrics.

reviews.finding: The compatibility provider also lacked the complete plan contract.
reviews.correction: Implemented the complete read-only contract with no fabricated metrics or native ownership transfer.

reviews.finding: Provider registration did not exercise the plan-required sync-event hook.
reviews.correction: Registry now invokes sync registration and fails closed on registration errors.

reviews.finding: Timeline service trusted the normalized item without cross-checking provider canonical URL, visibility, actions and correction projection methods.
Plan-required Most Viewed was absent.
reviews.correction: Added conditional Most Viewed ordering only when an owner provider returns privacy-safe real view counts.

reviews.finding: Plan-required Most Saved was absent.
reviews.correction: Added conditional Most Saved ordering only when an owner provider returns privacy-safe real save counts.

reviews.finding: No explicit timeline metric-sort privacy gate existed.
reviews.correction: Metrics require privacy_safe=true and bounded nonnegative owner counts; raw metrics are not emitted and unavailable metrics stay hidden.

reviews.finding: The plan-required reviewed/source-state refinement was incomplete.
reviews.correction: Added strict review-state filtering across service, HTML and REST.

reviews.finding: Source verification refinement was absent.
reviews.correction: Added strict verified/unverified source-state filtering without creating a new verification authority.

reviews.focus: public HTML refinement UI and state preservation
reviews.finding: UI exposed only latest/oldest and lacked review/source controls.
reviews.correction: Added review/source selects and conditional metric-sort options with URL-state preservation.

reviews.finding: REST did not accept/return the new governed refinements.
reviews.correction: Added strict metric sort, review/source args and applied-sort/available-sort output.

reviews.finding: New review/source refinements were not part of the explicit filtered-query detector.
reviews.correction: Included both in filtered-query/noindex detection and state accounting.

reviews.finding: Pagination had Previous/Next only, while the plan requires accessible Load More plus numbered fallback.
reviews.correction: Added explicit Load More and retained a next-page fallback; no infinite-scroll-only behavior introduced.

reviews.finding: Shell, publication, authoring, private dashboard, assurance and global search/ranking ownership remain intact.
Profile, directory, clinic, verification, conversion, network and notification authorities remain owner-native after current-source reconciliation.

reviews.focus: final source parity and external truth
reviews.finding: No additional File 25-owned source defect was found after corrections. External acceptance remains unpromoted.
